description: The donut chart, titled “Stimulus Type,” visually represents the distribution of different types of stimuli used in the context of generative AI’s application in journalism, as discussed in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” The chart is divided into ten distinct segments, each labeled with a stimulus category and its corresponding percentage. The largest segment is “Draft/Other” at 26.4%, shown in dark red, followed by “Press Release” at 18.7% (golden yellow) and “External News Article” at 18.1% (dark green). Other notable segments include “Interview” (8.8%, dark blue), “Organizational Report” (7.7%, light purple), and “Event Posting” (6.6%, maroon). Smaller segments include “Organizational Website” (4.9%, lavender), “Intra-agency” (partially obscured, light blue), “Email” (2.7%, light green), and “Social Media Post” (1.1%, orange). The chart uses a color-coded legend implicitly through direct labeling, with percentages displayed next to each segment. The “Intra-agency” label is partially cut off at the bottom, suggesting a possible formatting issue in the original figure. The segments are arranged clockwise around the donut, roughly in descending order of magnitude, though not strictly sorted. The central white space contains the title “Stimulus Type” in bold, emphasizing the chart’s focus on categorizing input sources or triggers for AI-assisted journalistic work.
